{{Quote|The Jedi Code teaches us, but the Force guides us.|Master Quilb|audio=Quilb-TOR.flac|<ref name="TOR" />}}
'''Quilb''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Cathar/Legends|Cathar]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] serving the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. Residing at the [[Jedi Temple (Tython)/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tython/Legends|Tython]], Quilb was know by the Jedi for being fond of other species and taking in orphans. A [[Unidentified Flesh Raider baby|baby Flesh Raider]] was found near [[Kaleth]] and brought to him. Quilb decided to bring the baby up in discussion with the Jedi Council before taking him in.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Quilb was originally named "Master Squib" in the game's conversation files.
